en: Midnight. The Temple wall.
A shadow crosses the wall. No one sees it come in.
Inside, the disciples' dormitory.
Ren. Wake up.
Master? What's wrong?
Someone has entered the Temple. Go see who dares.
Just me?
If it's one, you're enough.
If there are more… shout.
zh: 一道黑影翻过寺墙。没有人看见它进来。
有人闯进了寺院。去看看是谁这么大胆。

en: The wall, a moment later.
He's escaping over the wall!
The ninja leaps and the night swallows him. He took nothing.
Nothing stolen. Nothing broken.
Then… why did he come?
zh: 忍者一跃，黑夜吞没了他。他什么也没拿。
没有偷东西。也没有弄坏什么。

en: Morning. The training yard.
The sun beats down on the wooden posts. The disciples have trained since dawn.
Gon caught a scout in the forest.
And you let yours get away, Ren.
He was fast.
Excuses.
Enough. Before we question him, the Abbot wants to see how you fight.
You'll face the scout Gon brought in. His hands are tied: he can't use Kawarimi.
Tied up and all, I'll still beat you, little monk.
zh: 阳光照在木桩上。弟子们从黎明起就在练功。
刚在林子里抓到了一个斥候。
够了。审问之前，方丈想看看你怎么打。
你要对付刚带回来的斥候。他双手被缚，用不了替身术。
就算绑着，我也能赢你，小和尚。

en: The yard, at noon.
Good. You surround with patience. That's what matters.
Master, why do we always surround?
Why not just strike?
Because that is how we were taught.
That's not an answer.
zh: 很好。你包围时很有耐心。这才是关键。
师父，我们为什么总是包围？
因为我们就是这样被教的。

en: That afternoon. The road to the village.
Ren goes down to the village for rice. The empty basket bumps against his back.
So quiet…
Not a bird. Not a breath of wind.
Three shadows drop from the trees.
It's the Abbot's disciple. Surround him!
zh: 那天下午。通往村子的路。
仁下山去村里买米。空篮子在背上一下下地撞着。

en: The road, at sunset.
Why were you waiting for me?
Ask the old man what he keeps down below!
Down below?
zh: 去问那老头，他在下面藏了什么！

en: Night. The Temple cells.
Beneath the old wing of the Temple a single torch burns. Behind the bars, someone isn't sleeping.
Your friends ambushed me on the road. What are they after?
I'm not telling you anything, monk.
Then we wait. I have all night.
A dull thud on the roof. Then another.
Ren! They've come to get him out!
zh: 寺院旧翼之下，只燃着一支火把。铁栏后面，有人没有睡。
你的同伙在路上伏击了我。他们想要什么？
我什么都不会告诉你，和尚。
那我们就等。我有一整夜。
屋顶上一声闷响。接着，又是一声。

en: The smoke clears. The cells.
The rescuers fled. They left the scout behind.
Your friends abandoned you.
They didn't abandon me. They left me here to talk to you.
Listen, kid. We didn't come to steal.
**We came to warn you.**
Warn us about what?
What your Abbot keeps down below…
The torch goes out on its own. A cold mist seeps in under the door.
At the cell door stands a white fox. No one saw it come in.
It is not yet time for him to know.
…Yes, my lady.
My lady? Who…?
The fox and the scout vanish into the mist.
The cell is still shut. Locked. From the outside.
zh: 救人的忍者逃了。斥候被留了下来。
他们没有丢下我。是留我下来跟你说话。
听着，小子。我们不是来偷东西的。
你们方丈藏在下面的东西……
火把自己熄灭了。一股冰冷的雾从门缝下渗进来。
牢门口站着一只白狐。没有人看见它进来。
还不是让他知道的时候。
白狐和斥候消失在雾中。
牢门依旧紧闭。上了锁。从外面锁的。

en: Minutes later. The north wall.
They're all over the wall! They want to cover the escape.
Gon, did you see the fox?
What fox?
Ren! Focus!
zh: 墙上到处都是他们！他们想掩护撤退。
刚，你看到那只狐狸了吗？

en: The ninjas retreat into the forest. The wall falls silent.
They run like rabbits!
"We came to warn you."
Warn us about what?
zh: 忍者们退回了树林。寺墙重归寂静。

en: Dawn. The main gate.
The morning mist covers the steps. Someone waits at the gate, alone.
The Abbot's disciple.
Who are you?
They tell me you surround well.
Someone who's going to take back what's ours. Today, or next time.
zh: 晨雾笼罩着台阶。有人独自在门前等候。
一个要拿回我们东西的人。今天，或者下一次。

en: Well fought.
But you understand nothing of what you defend.
Wait!
Later. The Abbot's hall.
Master, the ninja said they came to warn us.
He spoke of something we keep down below.
No one spoke with anyone, Ren.
But…
**Forget it.** That is an order.
The floor trembles, ever so slightly.
A grey dust falls from the ceiling.
Master…?
It isn't dust. It's **ash**.
It has begun.
zh: 但你根本不懂你在守护什么。
师父，那个忍者说他们是来警告的。
他说我们在下面藏着什么东西。
屋顶落下一层灰色的尘。

en: Days later. Outside the Temple, without permission.
Ren slips down the mountain stairs before dawn. No one saw him leave.
If the Abbot won't tell me, I'll find out myself.
Sneaking out, kid? *hic*
Master Tao! Don't tell anyone.
Me? I didn't see a thing. I never see anything. *hic*
I'll come with you.
zh: 天亮前，仁顺着山间石阶溜了下去。没人看见他离开。
既然方丈不肯告诉我，我就自己去查。
我？我什么也没看见。我从来什么都看不见。*嗝*

en: The trail, further on.
Footprints in the mud. Light feet, the kind that don't want to be seen.
They head east. To the old shrine.
Do you know something?
I know how to drink.
The rest I forgot. *hic*
For someone who forgot everything, he reads tracks very well.
zh: 泥里有脚印。脚步很轻，是不想被人看见的那种。
一个什么都忘了的人，看脚印倒是看得很准。

en: The only bridge over the river.
The river roars below. The ninjas block the bridge from end to end.
It will be a long battle, with nowhere to retreat.
Master, will you help me?
I'll wait for you on this side. I have… things to do. *hic*
zh: 河水在下面咆哮。忍者们从头到尾堵住了整座桥。
这一战会很漫长，而且无路可退。
我在这边等你。我还有……事要办。*嗝*

en: The far bank.
I made it!
On the other side of the river, Tao raises his gourd in a toast.
I never doubted you!
Well. A little.
zh: 河的另一边，陶举起酒葫芦遥遥一敬。

en: The abandoned shrine.
Moss, fallen stones, a torii no one tends. And something carved into the rock.
Six stones in a hexagon, around a horned figure.
That's the Temple's symbol…
…and that's the clan's. Together?
No one has looked at those stones in centuries. What's a monk doing here?
And who are you?
Someone who asked the same thing you did.
Show me how you fight and I'll answer.
zh: 青苔，倒下的石块，一座无人照看的鸟居。还有刻在岩石上的东西。
六块石头排成六边形，围着一个长角的身影。
几百年没人看过这些石头了。一个和尚来这里做什么？
一个和你问过同样问题的人。
让我看看你怎么打，我就回答你。

en: I was a monk, you know.
They threw me out for asking what the Jade Scroll says.
The Scroll is sacred. Only the Abbot reads it.
Exactly.
And you never wondered why?
zh: 我以前也是和尚，你知道吗。
他们把我赶出来，只因为我问翡翠卷轴上写着什么。
卷轴是神圣的。只有方丈能读。

en: The forest, at night.
They followed you from the shrine. There are many.
How many?
Among the bamboo, a shadow. Two. Four.
Shinobi slip through any gap.
Then leave no gaps.
zh: 他们从神社一路跟着你。人很多。
竹林间，一道影子。两道。四道。
忍者会从任何缝隙钻进来。

en: A fallen shinobi drops something as he flees: a small scroll tied with red thread.
It has the Shogun's seal.
Read it.
*(reading)* "Bring the Jade Scroll before the new moon."
The new moon is in ten days.
zh: 一个倒下的忍者逃跑时掉了样东西：一卷用红线系着的小卷轴。
*（读着）*“新月之前，带回翡翠卷轴。”

en: The valley. Thick fog.
Nothing stays still in the fog. Ren lost Jubei an hour ago.
Jubei? Jubei!
Follow me, little monk.
You! What are you?
The one who remembers.
Follow me, and don't get lost.
zh: 雾里没有什么是静止的。一个时辰前，仁就跟丢了十兵卫。

en: The edge of the valley.
Tomorrow you will meet someone who asks your same questions.
Who?
Someone from the other side.
The other side… of the valley? Or of the war?
zh: 明天你会遇见一个和你问同样问题的人。
另一边……山谷的另一边？还是战争的另一边？

en: The shrine, at dawn.
Two shadows in the same clearing. Neither moves first.
A monk. Alone. In my forest.
It's not your forest.
You see her too? The white fox.
*(surprised)* Yes.
Then you know something is wrong.
I'll still beat you.
zh: 同一片空地上，两道身影。谁也没有先动。
一个和尚。独自一人。在我的林子里。
你也看得见她？那只白狐。
那你就知道有什么不对劲了。

en: You won. This time.
Your friend said they came to warn us. About what?
I don't know. Neither does my Shogun.
But ask your Abbot **what lies beneath the Temple**.
A smoke bomb. Aya is gone.
Beneath the Temple. Again.
zh: 你们的人说是来警告的。警告什么？
我不知道。我的将军也不知道。
但去问问你的方丈，**寺院底下有什么**。
一颗烟雾弹。绫已经不见了。

en: The Temple. Ren returns after a week.
The incense still burns, as always. But there are guards where there never were.
Ren! Where have you been?
Outside. Learning things.
The Abbot was furious. He locked the library.
He locked the library?
And he put guards on the crypt. Something's going on.
Let's spar, like before. I missed you.
zh: 寺院。仁在一周后回来了。
香火依旧燃着，一如往常。但以前从没有守卫的地方，如今站着守卫。
方丈大发雷霆。他把藏经阁锁上了。
还在地穴派了守卫。出事了。
我们打一场吧，像以前一样。我想你了。

en: You fight differently.
More… like them.
Gon, do you know what's in the crypt?
No one goes down there.
Only Tao.
zh: 刚，你知道地穴里有什么吗？

en: The novices' dormitory.
It's night, and the youngest ones aren't sleeping. They sit together, eyes wide open.
Brother Ren… we dream of fire.
All of you?
All of us. The same dream.
A horned thing beneath our feet.
They're just dreams. Come on, training.
zh: 夜里，最小的几个都没睡。他们挤在一起，眼睛睁得大大的。
一个长角的东西，在我们脚底下。

en: At last the novices fall asleep, exhausted.
A horned figure.
Like in the carvings at the shrine.
zh: 小沙弥们终于累得睡着了。
就像神社石刻上的那样。

en: Midnight. The library.
Ren forces the door. The shelves smell of dust and wax.
Someone stands by the altar. Waiting for him.
I knew you would come.
I want to read the Scroll.
It isn't here.
And if it were, you'd have to get past me first.
zh: 仁撬开了门。书架上满是灰尘和蜡的气味。
祭坛旁有人。一直在等他。
就算在，你也得先过我这一关。

en: There is a seal, Ren. Beneath the Temple.
It is breaking.
And the Abbot?
He says he can renew it alone. That no one else needs to know.
Do you believe him?
zh: 有一道封印，仁。在寺院底下。
他说他能独自重修封印。说别人不必知道。

en: Dawn. The courtyard covered in ash.
Last night's tremor split the courtyard. Grey smoke rises from the crack.
Ninjas on the wall! They're using the chaos!
It's not their fault!
It's coming from below!
zh: 昨夜的震动在庭院裂开一道缝。灰色的烟从里面冒出来。
墙上有忍者！他们想趁乱进来！

en: The ninjas withdraw. The ash keeps falling, like dirty snow.
Through the ash, for a moment, Ren sees two red eyes.
…Did you see that?
See what?
zh: 忍者们撤退了。灰烬还在落，像脏了的雪。
灰烬之中，有那么一瞬，仁看见了两只红眼。

en: The Abbot's hall.
The tremors are the clan's doing.
Kage wants the Scroll to free something he doesn't understand.
Master, Mei said that…
Mei talks too much.
Ren, you will go to the clan's pagoda. You will defeat Kage.
It is the only way to protect the Temple.
Me?
You are the best I have.
zh: 地震是忍者一族搞的鬼。
影想要卷轴，去释放一个他根本不懂的东西。
仁，你去忍者的宝塔。去打败影。
这是保护寺院唯一的办法。

en: The corridor, on the way out.
*(quietly)* Ren. Don't go.
It's an order from the Abbot.
Orders can be wrong too.
The gate, at night.
Ren leaves with nothing but the clothes on his back. On the last step, someone blocks his way.
To the pagoda, kid? *hic*
Let me pass, master.
The old man is using you.
If you fight Kage, no one will be left for what's coming.
What's coming?
For once, Tao doesn't seem drunk.
Beat me and I'll let you go. Lose and you stay.
zh: 仁只身出发。在最后一级台阶上，有人拦住了他。
你要是跟影打，就没人能对付接下来的东西了。
这一次，陶看起来一点也不醉。
赢了我，我就放你走。输了，你就留下。

en: Bah.
You're as stubborn as Daishin.
Who is Daishin?
Ask Kage. If he lets you talk. *hic*
Ren goes down the mountain. Behind him, the Temple bell stays silent.
zh: 去问影吧。如果他肯让你开口的话。*嗝*
仁走下山去。在他身后，寺院的钟没有响。

en: The clan's pagoda. Five floors.
Ren arrives alone. The door is open, as if they were expecting him.
The Shogun said the Abbot's boy would come.
That he should climb, if he can.
zh: 仁独自到来。大门敞开着，好像早就在等他。
将军说过，方丈的那个小子会来。
让他上来，如果他有本事的话。

en: One floor.
Four to go.
Second floor. The floor of fans.
Red lanterns, curtains that move without wind. And behind every curtain, an open fan.
Aya told us about you. She said you ask a lot of questions.
Is she here?
She's gone. To the Temple.
While you climb up, she goes down.
zh: 红灯笼，无风自动的帘幕。每道帘幕后，都有一把张开的扇子。
绫提起过你。她说你问题很多。
你往上爬的时候，她正往下走。

en: Aya at the Temple…
And the Abbot, alone?
Third floor. The rafters.
The Tengu leap from beam to beam. They never touch the floor.
Come down and fight!
Two paths, one same night.
Hurry, little monk.
zh: 天狗在梁与梁之间跳跃。从不落地。

en: Wait! What's happening at the Temple?
What had to happen.
From the railing, the Temple can be seen far away. Above it, a red light that isn't the dawn.
zh: 从栏杆望去，能看见远处的寺院。寺院上空，有一道不是晨光的红光。

en: Fourth floor.
I told you we'd meet again.
I'm not here to steal anything.
I've come to talk to your Shogun.
No one talks to the Shogun without going through me.
zh: 我是来找你们将军谈的。
不过我这一关，谁也别想见将军。

en: Go up.
But when he tells you the truth, you'll wish you hadn't heard it.
zh: 但等他告诉你真相，你会宁愿自己没听过。

en: The last door.
Behind the door, a single breath. Slow.
The Abbot told me to defeat him.
Tao told me to listen to him.
No one enters.
zh: 门后，只有一个人的呼吸。缓慢。

en: The elite guard falls. The door opens by itself.
*(from inside)* Come in, disciple of Hōshin.
zh: 精锐守卫倒下了。门自己开了。

en: The top of the pagoda.
Wind. The moon over the mountains. And a man in black armor who doesn't turn around.
Hōshin sent you to kill me.
To defeat you.
To him it's the same thing.
Very well. Surround me if you can.
zh: 风。群山上的月亮。还有一个身穿黑甲、没有回头的男人。

en: …You won.
Now listen, because no one else will tell you.
Beneath your Temple sleeps the Ash Oni. It was sealed three hundred years ago.
Your Abbot knows the seal is breaking. He has known for years.
Then he'll renew it.
He can't. **Not alone.**
The clan always knew: the Scroll is one half of our pact.
What pact?
That I don't know. That's why I wanted it.
My master… lied to me.
In the distance, above the Temple, a column of ash rises.
zh: 现在听着，因为没人会告诉你。
你的寺院底下沉睡着灰烬鬼。它在三百年前被封印。
你的方丈知道封印正在破碎。他早就知道了。
他做不到。**一个人做不到。**
忍者一直都知道：卷轴是我们盟约的一半。
这我不知道。所以我才想要它。
远处，寺院上空，升起一道灰烬之柱。

en: The clan's pagoda. Night.
High on the mountain, the clan's red lanterns never go out.
The Jade Scroll belongs to us.
The monks stole it centuries ago.
What does the Scroll say, my lord?
That doesn't matter. What matters is that it comes home.
Always the same answer.
Later. The Temple wall.
The wall guard.
Get past him without a sound.
Like a shadow.
zh: 山巅之上，一族的红灯笼从不熄灭。
几百年前被和尚们偷走了。
那不重要。重要的是让它回家。

en: The guard sleeps against the wall. He never noticed.
We're in.
Good. Now, the hard part.
zh: 卫兵靠着墙睡着了。他什么也没察觉。

en: The novices' yard.
A shadow! Alarm!
They're kids.
They haven't learned Jade Meditation yet.
Don't let them shout any louder.
zh: 他们还没学会翡翠冥想。

en: Kuro… why do we surround?
In the clan they teach us to surround too.
Because that's how you win.
But why **that** way?
You ask too many questions.
zh: 可是为什么**偏偏**是这样？

en: The inner courtyard.
A master makes his rounds by the incense burner. He doesn't look up.
They never look up.
Aya drops onto the guard master before he can react.
zh: 一位师父在香炉旁巡视。他没有抬头。
绫从天而降，守卫师父还没反应过来。

en: From the rooftop, Aya sees something strange: the monks aren't guarding the library.
They're guarding a **staircase** that leads beneath the Temple.
What are they keeping down there?
zh: 绫在屋顶上看到了奇怪的事：和尚们守的不是藏经阁。
他们守着一道通往寺院地下的**阶梯**。

en: The entrance to the crypt.
A mouth of stone in the ground. Below, the torches burn without flickering.
Halt! No one goes down.
What's down there?
I don't know.
And you won't find out either.
zh: 地上一张石头的嘴。下面，火把燃烧得纹丝不动。

en: Gon lies sprawled on the steps. Aya goes down to the stone door.
The stone is **warm**. And it beats, slowly.
…Like a heart.
zh: 刚倒在台阶上。绫走到石门前。
石头是**温的**。而且在缓缓跳动。

en: Bells. The whole Temple wakes.
They've seen us! We're leaving.
But the staircase…
Now, Aya!
The north wall.
They escape over the north wall. One of their own didn't make it.
Where's the scout?
In the cells. They caught him.
We're going back for him.
zh: 他们从北墙逃了出去。有一个同伴没能跟上。

en: The next night. The cells.
Aya comes back alone to rescue the scout.
Mei is waiting for her.
You came back for your comrade. That says something good about you.
I don't need your approval.
No. You need to get past me.
zh: 你回来救你的同伴。这说明你心地不坏。

en: …Go.
Take him with you.
You're letting us go?
Something greater than this war is coming.
The less blood, the better.
The crypt staircase.
What you came looking for is not what you think.
Who are you?
Beneath Aya's feet, the stone **beats** once more. Stronger.
zh: 比这场战争更大的东西就要来了。
你来寻找的，不是你以为的那样东西。
在绫的脚下，石头又**跳动**了一下。更强了。

en: The pagoda.
My lord, the crypt door beats.
There is something alive beneath the Temple.
Monks' superstitions.
I touched it myself.
Kuro. Train her. She is distracted.
Yes, my lord.
You fight with anger.
I fight with questions.
Questions don't win battles.
Not yet.
The Temple's zen garden.
Sand raked into perfect circles. No one ever steps on it.
Until today.
The monks have sealed off the garden. Break through before more arrive.
zh: 耙成完美圆圈的白沙。从来没人踩过。
和尚们封锁了庭园。得在更多人赶来之前杀出一条路。

en: In the center of the garden, six stones form a hexagon.
One of them is cracked.
Six stones…
Like the board.
zh: 庭园中央，六块石头围成一个六边形。

en: The garden pass.
The Marble Tigers guard the way. They push everything in their path.
Big, slow and stubborn.
Like the monks.
zh: 石虎把守通道。挡路的一切都会被推开。

en: Six stones, two hands.
Do you remember the song, kunoichi?
What song?
The one your clan stopped singing.
zh: 你还记得那首歌吗，女忍？
你们一族不再唱的那首。

en: A mountain road.
A ninja who looks at old stones. Strange.
You know them?
I was a monk. I know what the Temple keeps quiet.
Beat me and I'll tell you what the clan forgot.
zh: 一个盯着老石头看的忍者。真稀奇。
我以前是和尚。我知道寺院隐瞒了什么。
赢了我，我就告诉你忍者一族忘了什么。

en: Your clan says the Scroll is theirs. They're not lying.
But they don't remember **why** either.
Ask your Shogun what the Scroll says.
I already asked. He doesn't know.
Then no one in this war knows what they're fighting for.
zh: 你们一族说卷轴是他们的。他们没说谎。
但他们也不记得**为什么**。
去问你的将军，卷轴上写着什么。
那这场战争里，就没有一个人知道自己为何而战。

en: The forest, at night.
Smoke bombs everywhere. Don't let any monk know where you are.
Now.
Tomorrow you will meet someone who asks your same questions.
zh: 烟雾弹四起。别让任何僧人知道你在哪。
明天你会遇见一个和你问同样问题的人。

en: Fox… who are you?
The one who remembers what you all forgot.
zh: 记得你们所遗忘之事的那一个。

en: The shrine, at dawn.
Two shadows in the same clearing. Neither moves first.
A monk. Alone. In my forest.
It's not your forest.
You see her too? The white fox.
*(surprised)* Yes.
Then you know something is wrong.
I'll still beat you.
zh: 同一片空地上，两道身影。谁也没有先动。
一个和尚。独自一人。在我的林子里。
你也看得见她？那只白狐。
那你就知道有什么不对劲了。

en: You won. This time.
Your comrade said you came to warn us. About what?
I don't know. Neither does my Shogun.
But ask your Abbot **what lies beneath the Temple**.
My master never lies.
Then it won't be hard to ask him.
zh: 你的同伴说你们是来警告的。警告什么？
我不知道。我的将军也不知道。
但去问问你的方丈，**寺院底下有什么**。

en: Night. Inside the Temple.
Aya slips in once more.
This time she isn't looking for the library. She's looking for the staircase.
New guards. Lots of them.
zh: 这一次她找的不是藏经阁。她找的是那道阶梯。

en: The crypt staircase.
Steps that go down, and down.
…It's hot.
With every step, the air grows hotter.
zh: 每走一步，空气就更热一分。

en: The crypt.
An enormous hall. On the floor, six stones in a hexagon around a crack.
Three of the stones are cracked. Ash seeps out of them.
This is a seal.
zh: 一座巨大的石厅。地上，六块石头排成六边形，围着一道裂缝。
其中三块石头已经裂开。灰烬从裂缝中渗出。

en: From the crack rises a voice, like embers.
…Kagerō…
Who is Kagerō?
zh: 裂缝中升起一个声音，如同余烬。

en: The ash takes shape. Grey pieces, with no owner, move on their own.
What is this?!
zh: 灰烬聚成了形。灰色的棋子，没有主人，自己在动。

en: The ash pieces crumble.
But they gather again. More slowly.
They can't be defeated. Only held back.
zh: 但它们又聚拢起来。更慢了。
打不赢它们。只能拦住它们。

en: A ninja in my crypt. *hic*
That hasn't happened in three hundred years.
Are you going to call the guards?
No. We're going to play.
If you beat me, I'll tell you a story.
zh: 一个忍者，跑进了我的地穴。*嗝*
你要是赢了，我就给你讲个故事。

en: Once upon a time there was a monk, Daishin…
…and a ninja, Kagerō.
They surrounded a demon with six stones. Together. Both hands.
A monk and a ninja… together?
That's what the Temple erased. And what your clan forgot. *hic*
zh: 从前有一个和尚，叫大心……
他们用六块石头包围了一个恶鬼。一起。两只手。
一个和尚和一个忍者……一起？
这就是寺院抹去的。也是你的族人遗忘的。*嗝*

en: The crypt, before dawn.
And now run.
The Abbot comes down every night to look at the cracks.
Footsteps on the stairs.
zh: 方丈每天夜里都会下来看那些裂缝。

en: Outside. First light.
Aya leaves the Temple at first light.
Her hands are shaking.
zh: 绫在第一缕晨光中离开了寺院。

en: The pagoda.
My lord, the Scroll is not a treasure. It's a ritual.
A seal. It needs the Temple and the clan.
A drunken monk's tales.
Kuro will go to the Temple tonight and take the Scroll by force.
If you do that, you'll break the seal.
Then step aside, Aya.
zh: 主上，卷轴不是宝物。是一场仪式。
一道封印。它需要寺院，也需要我们一族。
今夜黑会去寺院，用武力夺回卷轴。
你们这么做，封印就会破。

en: …You beat me.
Then you go. But bring it back.
*(from the shadows)* Bring me the Scroll, Aya. Or don't come back.
zh: 那就你去吧。但要把它带回来。
*（从暗处）*把卷轴带给我，绫。否则别回来。

en: The last night before the new moon.
The Temple is emptier than ever. They say the Abbot's disciple went to the pagoda.
Ren and me.
Each of us in the other's house.
zh: 寺院比任何时候都空。听说方丈的弟子去了宝塔。

en: The library is in sight.
The library doors.
The Marble Tigers guard the library. They push everything in their path.
You again.
zh: 石虎守着藏经阁。挡路的一切都会被推开。

en: The ground shakes.
The lamps go out on their own.
It's waking up.
I came to ask you something.
Are you going to fight me again?
Yes. To know if you're ready.
If you read it, there's no turning back.
zh: 是。看看你准备好了没有。
一旦读了，就再也回不了头。

en: You're ready.
I'll distract the ones at the door.
A monk helping a ninja. Like in Tao's story.
zh: 一个和尚帮一个忍者。就像陶讲的故事。

en: You again. Ren isn't here to defend you.
I didn't come for him.
Too bad for you.
zh: 又是你。仁不在，没人护着你。

en: Why don't you finish me?
Because you're not my enemy.
None of you are.
I let you go once.
And not now.
Now I can't.
The Abbot is inside.
*(stepping aside)* Let someone read it. At last.
The library. The Jade Scroll on the altar.
No one has beaten me in forty years.
There's a first time for everything.
If you beat me, read it.
And you will understand why I kept silent.
zh: 藏经阁。翡翠卷轴放在祭坛上。
你会明白我为什么一直沉默。

en: Aya unrolls the Jade Scroll.
*(reading)* "Six stones around. One hand of the Temple, one hand of the Shadow. If one is missing, the seal will not close."
…It's not a weapon. It's a ritual. And it needs both of us.
I know. That's why I never said it.
I would rather break alone than ask the clan for help.
The ground splits open beneath the courtyard. A column of ash rises to the sky.
I have the Scroll.
But alone, it's useless.
zh: *（读着）*“六石环绕。寺院一手，暗影一手。缺其一，封印不合。”
……这不是武器。是仪式。而且需要我们两边。
我知道。所以我从未说出口。
我宁愿独自崩溃，也不愿向忍者求助。
庭院底下的大地裂开。一道灰烬之柱冲上天空。
但只有我一个人，它毫无用处。

en: The same night. The pagoda and the library.
Ren defeated Kage. Aya defeated the Abbot. At the same hour.
Beneath the Temple, the last stone splits.
**At last. Fighting each other, as always.**
The Temple courtyard, in grey flames.
Master Tao! What is that?
What your Abbot didn't want to tell you. Surround it, kid. Now!
zh: 仁击败了影。绫击败了方丈。同一时刻。
寺院底下，最后一块石头裂开了。
寺院庭院，燃着灰色的火焰。
你的方丈不肯告诉你的东西。包围它，小子。快！

en: The Oni retreats into the crack. But it doesn't close.
Surrounding it stops it. **It doesn't seal it.**
zh: 灰烬鬼退回了裂缝。但裂缝没有合上。
包围它能阻止它。**却封印不了它。**

en: The stone garden, split in two.
Kuro! Help me!
That thing came from beneath the Temple!
I know. Let's surround it.
zh: 那东西是从寺院底下出来的！

en: The Oni retreats again. Bigger.
One hand alone is not enough. It never was.
The courtyard. Ren and Aya, face to face.
Kage told me half.
The Scroll tells the other. One hand of the Temple and one of the Shadow.
Then… together.
*(taking human form)* Like Daishin and Kagerō. I was the promise they made to each other. And I was fading.
zh: 灰烬鬼又退了回去。变得更大了。
一只手是不够的。从来都不够。
卷轴写着另一半。寺院一手，暗影一手。
*（化为人形）*就像大心和阳炎。我是他们彼此许下的诺言。而我正在熄灭。

en: *(wounded, arriving)* Ren… forgive me.
*(arriving over the wall)* Aya. Do what the Scroll says.
Six stones. Two hands. Now.
zh: 六块石。两只手。就是现在。

en: Six stones light up green and red. The crack closes.
The Oni dies out like an ember in the rain.
A week later.
The seal will hold for another three hundred years.
If we don't forget again.
Then let's not forget.
One duel a year. Temple against clan. On the board.
And so began the **duels of honor**: monks and ninjas, facing each other so they never forget how to surround a demon.
Until the next crack.
zh: 六块石头亮起绿光与红光。裂缝合上了。
灰烬鬼如雨中的余烬般熄灭。
每年一场对决。寺院对忍者。在棋盘上。
**荣誉之战**就此开始：僧人与忍者彼此对弈，永远记得如何包围恶鬼。
